RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not automatically prove discrimination. For a "Head of" role, financial institutions heavily prioritize regulatory relations, governance, and stakeholder management over purely technical depth; the selected candidate's regulatory experience and finance degree are legitimate, standard qualifications. 

Raising sex or panel composition without concrete, documented proof of disparate treatment will be viewed as unsubstantiated, damaging your professional reputation and eliminating future opportunities at the institution. Delays in written feedback are common in corporate HR. Follow up politely to request constructive feedback focused on leadership competencies rather than alleging discrimination.
